note: Real production sessions (webs elements only) from the DOM-based production system, 2021-01-18 portal dump. Binaries are NOT in git (user data); this manifest defines the corpus. Production stitches are the DOM-based reference outputs.

cases.name: rw1_newsportal
cases.description: news portal, single page, deep scroll

expect.note: Single article. Measured 4735; the production JPG is 4737 (the manifest's 4744 and production's own reference are CAPTURED EXTENT, not document height — the scrollbar thumb puts this document at ~13000px and the user never scrolled that far). The page RELOADS itself mid-session; recognising the post-reload view as the same page is what keeps this at one page, so a drop to 2 pages is the regression this guards.

cases.name: rw2_textpage
cases.description: dense text page, short single-page session

expect.note: Reached the document bottom. Measured 3980 vs the production JPG's 3981 — 1px.

Page-for-page with production (6520/960/4320). Page 0 contains a -4563px scroll jump that is re-localized against its own canvas by CONTENT; if that regresses, the jump reappears as a bogus REVISIT navigation while the heights stay correct — so navigation semantics, not geometry, is what breaks first here.

cases.name: rw4_portal
cases.description: dark dashboard portal, 4 pages, very deep scroll

expect.note: THE re-localization case. The deep page is scrolled by DRAGGING the scrollbar thumb: 4356px in one frame step, so consecutive frames share no pixels and the identifier reports 0 matching blocks. Re-localized from the scrollbar to 11618 vs production's 11624; before re-localization this was 5542 plus a bogus third page. Production emits 4 stitches for 4 visits (2 of them the same deep page), so the page COUNT is not comparable to production — 2 is our distinct-page count. 4446px of this document was never on screen and is declared in gaps[].

cases.name: rw5_mobileframe
cases.description: mobile flow inside phone mockup, 19 pages (hard case)

expect.note: Mobile flow inside a phone mockup. Production emits 19 stitches under a HIGH sensitivity setting (a new document version per mutation); we merge revisits under Normal, so the count is deliberately not comparable — 5 is our measured baseline and this is a drift guard only. Per-page heights track production within 8px where they correspond.
